scope: All equation/model entries in the shared atlas coverage inventory. Formulas are representative forms or explicitly identified schematic systems; they do not supply every closure or implementation. Status and coverage IDs are matched at build time.

groups.ja: 流体・場・運動論・基礎モデル
groups.en: Fluids, fields, kinetic and foundational models

groups.ja: 生物・化学・反応拡散モデル

note.ja: 一定速度aによる輸送。波形の移動、数値拡散、安定性へ。
note.en: Transport at constant speed a: translation, numerical diffusion and stability.

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries.

note.ja: 楕円型境界値問題。符号規約を確認し、反復解法・疎行列・境界条件をたどる。
note.en: Elliptic boundary-value problems: check sign conventions, iterative solvers, sparse matrices and boundaries.

note.ja: 非線形のスカラー保存則。衝撃波と膨張波を比較する。
note.en: A nonlinear scalar conservation law: compare shocks and rarefactions.

note.ja: 無次元化した代表流束。渋滞の上流伝播と希薄化を調べる。
note.en: A representative nondimensional flux: upstream jams and clearing fans.

note.ja: 1次元の保存形。状態方程式と初期・境界条件は各テストの定義を参照する。
note.en: The one-dimensional conservative form. Consult each test for its equation of state, initial data and boundaries.

note.ja: 前2式は平坦床・摩擦なしの1次元系。後2行は水深Hまわりの線形回転系。非線形流れのテストと、回転系のFourier記号の検証を区別します。
note.en: The first two equations are 1D flat-bed, frictionless flow; the remaining lines are the linear rotating system about depth H. Distinguish nonlinear flow tests from rotating-system Fourier-symbol checks.

equations.coverage_scope: Wet 1D flow and linear rotating Fourier symbols; no full geophysical dynamical core.

note.ja: 一定の等温音速cₛを用いる1次元の代表形。密度ジャンプの参照解へ。
note.en: A one-dimensional form with constant isothermal sound speed cₛ. Follow the density-jump reference solution.

note.ja: 透磁率を1とする理想MHDの代表形。Eは熱・運動・磁場を含む全エネルギー密度。解説でCT・GLMと発散の測り方、HLLDテストへ進めます。
note.en: Representative ideal MHD with magnetic permeability set to one. E is total thermal, kinetic and magnetic energy density. Follow CT/GLM, divergence conventions and HLLD tests.

note.ja: 一定密度・粘性の代表形。公開例は周期2次元MAC格子の射影法とTaylor–Green渦です。
note.en: A representative constant-density, constant-viscosity form. Public examples use periodic 2D MAC projection and a Taylor–Green vortex.

note.ja: 格子単位Δx=Δt=1の衝突・並進更新。D2Q9等温・低Mach数のせん断波とPoiseuille流を扱います。
note.en: Collision/streaming in lattice units Δx=Δt=1. Examples cover D2Q9 isothermal low-Mach shear waves and Poiseuille flow.

formula: \dot q=\frac{\partial H}{\partial p},\qquad\dot p=-\frac{\partial H}{\partial q}

note.ja: 正準方程式と分離可能なHamiltonianの代表形。調和・4次ポテンシャルの振動子で、エネルギー誤差とシンプレクティック性を比べます。
note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity.

formula: \boldsymbol a_i=-G\sum_{j\ne i}m_j\frac{\boldsymbol x_i-\boldsymbol x_j}{(|\boldsymbol x_i-\boldsymbol x_j|^2+\epsilon^2)^{3/2}}

note.ja: 孤立系のPlummer軟化力と、周期・平均密度除去のPoisson式は異なる境界問題です。公開例は静的な力と境界核の検証で、自己重力流体の時間発展ではありません。
note.en: Isolated Plummer-softened forces and periodic mean-subtracted Poisson are distinct boundary problems. Public examples check static forces and kernels, not coupled self-gravitating flow evolution.

equations.coverage_scope: Static force evaluations and boundary kernels; no coupled self-gravitating fluid evolution.

note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures.

name.ja: 補助的な双曲型拡散系

note.ja: τは擬似時間、Trは緩和時間。定常でp=uₓ、−νuₓₓ=fを回復します。物理時間の熱拡散とは区別します。
note.en: τ is pseudo-time and Tr a relaxation time. At steady state p=uₓ and −νuₓₓ=f are recovered; this is distinct from physical-time heat diffusion.

equations.coverage_scope: Periodic first-order steady-solution baseline, not physical-time heat diffusion.

note.ja: c=1、平坦なCartesian時空での理想流体の代表形。状態方程式と原始変数の回復が必要です。アトラスでは文献解説のみ。
note.en: Representative ideal fluid in flat Cartesian spacetime, c=1. An equation of state and primitive recovery are required. Atlas coverage is literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

note.ja: c=G=1、計量符号(−,+,+,+)の理想流体。背景計量を固定する場合と、Einstein方程式も解く場合を区別します。文献解説のみ。
note.en: Ideal fluid with c=G=1 and signature (−,+,+,+). Distinguish prescribed geometry from an evolved Einstein system. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

note.ja: 理想電気伝導の代表形。物質と電磁場の応力エネルギー、磁場制約、計量を組み合わせます。状態方程式・時空の扱いを含む完全系は解説先へ。文献解説のみ。
note.en: Representative ideal-conductivity form combining matter/EM stress-energy, magnetic constraints and geometry. Consult the chapter for closure and spacetime choices. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

name.ja: 相対論的放射モーメント・M1

note.ja: Gνを物質が受け取る四元力と定義した模式形。Rは放射の応力エネルギー、Pは放射圧テンソル。M1は角度モーメントの閉包で、放射分布全体を厳密に解くものではありません。文献解説のみ。
note.en: Schematic moment system defining Gν as the four-force received by matter. R is radiation stress-energy and P the radiation-pressure tensor. M1 closes angular moments rather than exactly resolving the full distribution. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

name.ja: 因果的な相対論的粘性流体

note.ja: 下段はIsrael–Stewart型の緩和を示す模式式で、完全な構成則ではありません。追加緩和変数を使わないBDNKなどの一階理論と区別します。因果性の条件は理論・状態方程式に依存し、文献解説のみです。
note.en: The second line only sketches Israel–Stewart-type relaxation; it is not a complete constitutive law. Distinguish first-order approaches such as BDNK without extra relaxation variables. Causality depends on the theory and equation of state. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

name.ja: ロジスティック個体群増殖

note.ja: 収容力Kを持つ密度依存の連続時間増殖モデル。離散ロジスティック写像とは区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map.

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct.

note.ja: 捕食・被食の結合ODE。位相平面と長時間積分を考えるためのモデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test.  Literature-only.

note.ja: 年齢aに沿う輸送と死亡、新生個体の非局所な更新境界を持つモデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Individuals move through age a at unit speed; newborns enter through a nonlocal renewal boundary. This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance.

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions.

note.ja: 拡散と増殖を結ぶ侵入前線。表示は規格化した代表形で、波の速度と境界条件は解説先へ。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed.

note.ja: 基質S、菌体X、収率Y、希釈率dの代表形。d=0の閉鎖バッチとケモスタットを区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Nutrient-limited biomass X, substrate S, yield Y and chemostat dilution d; d=0 gives a closed batch model. This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model.

note.ja: 電位とゲート変数z=m,h,nの膜モデル。元のイカ軸索モデルと、人心筋や空間ケーブルへの拡張を区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Voltage and gating variables z=m,h,n describe an ionic excitable membrane. A cable extension adds spatial axial current. The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey.

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes.

note.ja: 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations.

note.ja: 細胞密度が化学物質の勾配に応答する2場の代表的な縮約系。次元・境界・化学場の動態が重要です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics.

note.ja: 短距離活性化・長距離抑制の簡略代表形。飽和項や基礎生成項には複数の変種があります。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A representative simplified short-range activation/long-range inhibition model. Source densities, saturation and baseline production vary across the model family. This simplified formula is not a verbatim transcription of every original variant. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Source densities, saturation and baseline production vary across the model family. This simplified formula is not a verbatim transcription of every original variant.

name.ja: 流体・弾性構造と埋め込み境界

formula: \rho(\boldsymbol u_t+\boldsymbol u\cdot\nabla\boldsymbol u)=-\nabla p+\mu\Delta\boldsymbol u+\boldsymbol f

note.ja: 流体と変形構造の結合の入口。構造の力・構成則が別途必要で、既存の非圧縮ソルバーだけで実装済みとはなりません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Fluid coupled to a deformable structure; biological examples include valves and membranes, once a force/constitutive law is supplied. Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling.

name.ja: 化学マスター方程式とGillespie SSA
name.en: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA

formula: \partial_t P(\boldsymbol n,t)=\sum_j\left[a_j(\boldsymbol n-\boldsymbol\nu_j)P(\boldsymbol n-\boldsymbol\nu_j,t)-a_j(\boldsymbol n)P(\boldsymbol n,t)\right]

note.ja: 整数分子数n、反応ジャンプνj、傾向関数ajの確率モデル。Gillespie SSAは軌道を標本化する解法で、反応網自体とは区別します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Integer molecule counts, reaction jumps νj and propensities aj; SSA samples paths of this continuous-time Markov model. The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation.

name.ja: Mackey–Glass遅延生理フィードバック

note.ja: 遅延を持つフィードバックODE。初期値1点だけでなく、遅延区間の履歴関数が必要です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Delayed feedback in a normalized physiological control model; delay can change stability and oscillatory behavior. A scalar initial value alone is insufficient. The delayed ODE is distinct from a spatial reaction–diffusion model. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: A scalar initial value alone is insufficient. The delayed ODE is distinct from a spatial reaction–diffusion model.

name.ja: レプリケータ進化ゲーム動態

note.ja: 利得行列Aに対する戦略割合の動態。定常点と進化的安定戦略の同一視はしません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Strategy fractions reproduce according to relative payoff in a specified matrix game. No universal Lyapunov function or equivalence of fixed point and evolutionarily stable strategy is assumed. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: No universal Lyapunov function or equivalence of fixed point and evolutionarily stable strategy is assumed.

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue.

note.ja: 自己拡散・交差拡散と競争を含む系。表示は環境ポテンシャルを省いた一様環境での縮約形です。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Competition with density-dependent self- and cross-dispersal can produce spatial segregation. The displayed homogeneous-environment reduction omits the original environmental-potential terms. It is not equivalent to two independent scalar diffusion equations. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The displayed homogeneous-environment reduction omits the original environmental-potential terms. It is not equivalent to two independent scalar diffusion equations.

note.ja: 流入・除去を持つ自己触媒反応拡散。斑点分裂の画像だけで細胞分裂や線形Turing不安定性とは判定しません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A chemical feed/decay model whose spatial extension supports diverse spot and wave patterns. 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability.

note.ja: 心筋波の興奮・回復を表す現象論的な2変数モデル。単・双領域の組織モデルは追加の構成を要します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: A reduced phenomenological excitation/recovery model for cardiac waves and restitution. Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model.

name.ja: Repressilator mRNA・タンパク質回路

note.ja: 3遺伝子の環状抑制。mRNAとタンパク質を残す6変数形で、振動の有無はパラメータに依存します。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Three repressing genes form a cyclic network; retaining mRNA and protein gives six state variables. The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent.

name.ja: 遺伝子トグルスイッチ

note.ja: 相互抑制による規格化した2変数遺伝子スイッチ。任意のHill指数・生成率で双安定になるとは限りません。 文献解説のみ。
note.en: Mutual repression produces a possible bistable genetic switch in a normalized model. Bistability is not guaranteed for arbitrary Hill exponents or production rates. Induction, mRNA dynamics and noise are additional model choices. Literature-only.

equations.coverage_scope: Bistability is not guaranteed for arbitrary Hill exponents or production rates. Induction, mRNA dynamics and noise are additional model choices.

formula: \hat H_{\rm el}\Psi=E_{\rm el}\Psi,\qquad E_{\rm tot}=E_{\rm el}+\sum_{A<B}\frac{Z_AZ_B}{R_{AB}}

note.ja: 固定核・非相対論の電子多体固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。実行例は1電子の孤立水素型原子に限定。一般の多電子直接解法は未実装。
note.en: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic many-body eigenproblem; add nuclear repulsion separately. Runnable examples cover only isolated one-electron hydrogenic atoms, not direct general many-electron solutions.

formula: \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I

note.ja: 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式。一般に非局所な交換を含む。実行例は球対称1s² Heの局所還元に限定し、一般の分子・多電子のFock行列構築は未実装。
note.en: Closed-shell RHF spatial-orbital equations, generally with nonlocal exchange. Runnable code is restricted to the spherical 1s² helium local reduction; general molecular/many-electron Fock-matrix construction is not implemented.

formula: n(\mathbf r)=\sum_i f_i|\phi_i(\mathbf r)|^2,\quad \int n\,d\mathbf r=N,\quad v_{\rm xc}=\frac{\delta E_{\rm xc}}{\delta n}

note.ja: 密度汎関数の局所KS代表形。実行例は球対称He・スピン非偏極Dirac交換のみLDA。相関・GGA・hybrid・一般化KS・周期系は未実装。
note.en: Representative local KS equations. Runnable code covers spherical-helium spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange-only LDA. Correlation, GGA, hybrids, generalized KS and periodic systems are not implemented.

note.ja: 局所時間依存KSの代表形。初期状態、交換相関の記憶効果、断熱近似を区別する。実時間と線形応答の専用実装は未公開。
note.en: Representative local time-dependent KS equations. Distinguish initial-state dependence, exchange-correlation memory and adiabatic approximations. No dedicated real-time or response implementation is published.
